items.title: M2V integration (song -> music video)
items.detail: Wire PersonalSong to feed finished songs (audio + lyrics + cover + metadata) into the M2V music-video project. The registry already declares integrates_with: m2v and exposes 'Song generation' + 'Voice cloning' to the ecosystem; no actual contract/endpoint exists yet. Define the handoff (file drop or REST).

items.title: Register QI_PersonalSong in the Service Registry
items.detail: QI_PersonalSong (NSSM, :8088, serve.py, logs\service.log) is installed via PersonalSong_Install.bat but is NOT listed in C:\QIH\ecosystem\QI_Service_Registry.md. Add it so symptom->service->log triage works ecosystem-wide.

items.title: Port-block compliance decision
items.detail: Port 8088 was chosen before registry registration (2026-06-10) and falls outside every allocated block. The registry recommends migrating to 8502 in the 8500-8599 cousin block. Decide: keep 8088 (documented exception) or migrate (update serve.py, service, PersonalSong_Start_Server.bat, registry).

items.title: QI Brain logging
items.detail: Log generation sessions/decisions (model used, genre/language, voice-clone vs straight, success) to the QI Brain so the ecosystem has cross-project visibility. No qi.* calls exist in the codebase today.

items.title: Generation progress + cancel
items.detail: ACE-Step runs blocking in a single-worker executor; the UI waits with no progress feedback and no way to cancel. Surface infer_step progress (SSE/websocket) and a cancel control, and a job status endpoint for batch/queue runs.

items.title: Longer / structured songs
items.detail: Duration scales structure up to ~4 min, but very long generations are slow and untested. Add chunked/section-wise generation and stitching so full-length songs are reliable, plus a tempo/key control surfaced in the form.

items.title: Multi-singer duets
items.detail: Singers are per-song today. Allow assigning different singer presets to different sections (e.g. a duet, or a child + parent), building on the existing per-language singer map.

items.title: Smarter gender lock
items.detail: Gender verification (Demucs + librosa pitch) retries only once with a random seed. Make the retry budget configurable and cache the detected gender so re-rolls don't re-run Demucs unnecessarily.

items.title: Reusable cloned-voice profiles
items.detail: Today a clone is computed per cover from a fresh source. Persist isolated reference vocals as named voice profiles (the voices.json library exists for clips) so a loved one's voice can be reused across many songs without re-isolating each time.

items.title: Quality + speed tuning for Seed-VC
items.detail: diffusion-steps and inference-cfg-rate are hardcoded (25/30). Expose presets (fast/quality) and document the GPU-vs-CPU fallback behavior; add a quality check so a bad isolation doesn't ship a muddy cover.

items.title: Consent / ethics guardrail
items.detail: Voice cloning is powerful and personal. Add an explicit in-app consent acknowledgement and a watermark/metadata note on cloned outputs, since the app can clone any uploaded or YouTube voice.

items.title: Complete the Plex path end-to-end
items.detail: Plex sync is built but unverified without a configured token/section. Add a one-click Settings wizard (probe -> pick section -> test copy + scan) and surface sync status on each song card so 'play on Google Home' is provably working.

items.title: Finish YouTube Music onboarding
items.detail: Auth needs raw headers pasted from DevTools — fiddly. Add an in-app guided capture and a connection health badge; verify upload-all-from-library at scale.

items.title: Gift delivery polish
items.detail: Build on the QR greeting card + play page: scheduled reveal (don't show until the date), a themed per-occasion card gallery, and an email/LINE share that the Tasuke/QI notifier could send.

items.title: Refresh README to match the live engine
items.detail: README.md still documents the original MusicGen/HuggingFace + Suno approach and uvicorn main:app on :8000. The live engine is ACE-Step via serve.py on :8088. Rewrite it so setup instructions match reality (Ollama + ACE-Step + Seed-VC venv + ffmpeg_shared).

items.title: Document the dual ffmpeg setup
items.detail: Two ffmpeg builds ship (bundled BtbN shared DLLs for torchcodec + a gyan libcdio build for CD ripping). Document which is used where and pin versions, since this is a known setup gotcha (cu128 / FFmpeg).

items.title: Tests beyond smoke
items.detail: tests/ + a few _test_*.py scripts exist; add real coverage for lyric normalization, name injection, pronunciation swap, lever->ref_strength math, and the gender detector — the pure functions that are cheap and high-value to lock down.

items.title: Clean up stray dev artifacts
items.detail: The repo root holds scratch files (batch_log*.txt, name_check*.txt, final_*.txt, null, an oddly-named 'C:PersonalSongLOGSserver.log'). Sweep them into tools/ or delete; confirm requirements.txt reflects the real deps (it still lists transformers/torch generically, not acestep/demucs/seed-vc/edge-tts).
